title: Lumen Provider Catalog v1
description: Unified LLM / MT / ASR provider catalog for the Lumen product suite (lumen-translation, lumen-cut, lumen-asr, popclip-window). Single source of truth for endpoints, default models, auth, and per-provider behavior quirks.

spec.description: Format discriminator. Bump only with a new major schema file (v2).

version.description: Semver of the catalog DATA. Additive changes bump minor, corrections bump patch.

generated_from.description: Provenance: the source files this catalog was merged from.

id.description: Canonical stable id. Never renamed or removed within v1.

aliases.description: Ids historically used by the four consumer codebases (e.g. glm-cn, zhipu, volcengine). For migration mapping.

api_style.description: Request/response wire protocol. ollama = openai_compat plus Ollama-native passthrough params (think, options). asr_only = no chat protocol, see asr.api_style. local = in-process engine, no network endpoint.

region.description: Primary service region: cn = mainland-China-operated, global = overseas, both = separate cn+global endpoints, local = on-device.

endpoints.description: For openai_compat/anthropic/ollama: base_url WITHOUT the chat path (append chat_path). For google_translate/microsoft_translator: base_url IS the full endpoint. Absent for api_style=local/asr_only (asr.base_url carries the ASR endpoint).

chat_path.description: Path appended to base_url for chat requests. Default "/chat/completions"; "/messages" for anthropic.

models.description: Known models for UI dropdowns. Not exhaustive; users may enter others.

extra_headers.description: Static headers to send on every request (e.g. OpenRouter attribution, anthropic-version).

docs_url.description: Where users obtain an API key / read docs.

auth.description: How the API key is sent. Default when absent: header "Authorization", value_template "Bearer {key}".

value_template.description: Literal header value with {key} replaced by the user's API key.

no_thinking.description: How to disable chain-of-thought on the request side (mirrors lumen-corrector inject_no_thinking_params).

body_params.description: JSON object deep-merged into the chat request body.

model_filter.description: Case-insensitive substrings; when present, inject only if the model id matches one. Absent = always inject.

thinking_not_disableable_models.description: Models that ignore the no_thinking params (residual CoT must be stripped from responses).

strip_thinking_tags.description: Responses may contain <think>/<thinking> blocks that must be stripped client-side.

legacy_endpoints.description: Full URLs of deprecated endpoints still used by some consumers (keys: cn/global).

attribution_headers_configurable.description: extra_headers are neutral defaults the caller may override (OpenRouter HTTP-Referer / X-Title).

asr.description: Speech-to-text sub-config for providers with audio_transcription capability.

api_style.description: openai_audio = POST {base_url}/audio/transcriptions; websocket = realtime stream; http_batch = provider-specific batch HTTP; local = in-process engine.

status.description: wired = implemented in lumen-asr; config_only = selectable but client not implemented yet.
